hourglass.summary: Proportions are naturally balanced with a defined waist. Focus on maintaining symmetry, core stability, and highlighting your natural waistline.

fitness.focus: Total-body symmetry and core stability to support spinal alignment and natural curves.
exercises: Goblet squats for quadriceps and glute strength
Dumbbell overhead presses to maintain upper-body posture
Romanian deadlifts for hamstring and posterior chain balance
Side planks and bird-dogs for lateral core stability
fitness.cardio: Moderate-intensity interval training (HIIT) or brisk incline walking 2-3 sessions per week.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 2-3 days full-body resistance training + 2 days low-impact cardio and mobility.

nutritionTips: Focus on balanced macronutrients: quality lean protein, healthy fats (avocado, olive oil), and slow-digesting complex carbs.
Maintain consistent hydration: aim for 2.5 to 3 liters of water daily.
Incorporate regular fiber-rich vegetables to support steady energy levels.
postureTips: Mindful pelvic alignment: avoid excessive anterior pelvic tilt when standing.
Perform daily thoracic spine rotations to maintain upper back openness.
wellness.recovery: 7-8 hours of quality sleep with mindful stretching focusing on hip flexors and lower back.

tops: Fitted wrap tops
V-neck and scoop neck shirts
Tailored button-downs with waist darts
Fitted ribbed knits
outerwear: Tailored blazers that cinch at the waist
stylingTips: Highlight your natural waist with belts and fitted cuts.
Choose fabrics with gentle stretch that drape gracefully rather than stiff, boxy materials.
Ensure upper and lower garment volumes remain harmonious.
avoid: Oversized, shapeless boxy tunics
High stiff turtlenecks without waist definition
Drop-waist dresses

rectangle.summary: Athletic and naturally proportional silhouette with an even balance across shoulders, bust, and hips. Focus on building curve illusion through lateral deltoids, glutes, and waist-cinching styling.

fitness.focus: Hypertrophy for shoulder caps (lateral deltoids) and glutes to enhance anatomical curvature, alongside rotational core strength.
exercises: Barbell hip thrusts for maximum glute development
Dumbbell lateral raises to broaden shoulder cap profile
Walking lunges with dumbbells for lower body contouring
Russian twists and cable woodchops for oblique definition
fitness.cardio: Sprint interval training or stair-climber sessions to encourage lower-body muscular tone.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days targeted resistance training (emphasis on glutes and shoulders) + 1-2 days active recovery.

nutritionTips: Ensure adequate daily protein intake (1.6 - 2.0g per kg of body weight if pursuing muscle tone).
Fuel resistance sessions with pre-workout complex carbohydrates (oats, sweet potatoes).
Maintain balanced electrolyte levels especially on strength training days.
postureTips: Engage core brace during standing to prevent hyperextending knees.
Scapular retractions to keep chest proud and shoulders set back.
wellness.recovery: Foam roll hamstrings and lats post-workout; incorporate dynamic hip mobility routines.

tops: Ruffled, cowl, or sweetheart necklines
Off-the-shoulder and boat-neck tops
Peplum tops that create waist flounce
Crop tops paired with high-waisted bottoms
bottoms: Mom jeans or curved cargo pants
outerwear: Long duster coats with waist ties
stylingTips: Create the illusion of curves using belts, peplum details, and horizontal textures.
Experiment with dramatic necklines and layered textures to add dimensional depth.
Pair voluminous bottoms with fitted tops or vice versa.
avoid: Straight shapeless shift dresses
Vertical pinstripe suits without waist cinching
Monochrome boxy t-shirts

pear.summary: Hips and thighs form the prominent proportion with a slender upper torso and defined waist. Focus on upper-body posture and strength, and styling that draws the eye upward.

fitness.focus: Developing upper-body breadth (shoulders, chest, and back) to balance hip proportions, plus metabolic conditioning.
exercises: Seated dumbbell shoulder presses to expand biacromial breadth
Lat pulldowns and bent-over rows for a strong, wide upper back
Incline dumbbell chest presses for upper chest fullness
Bodyweight or kettlebell goblet squats for lower body conditioning
fitness.cardio: Incline walking, elliptical training, or rowing to build upper back endurance.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days upper-body focused strength + 1 day metabolic lower-body circuit + 2 days cardio.

nutritionTips: Focus on anti-inflammatory whole foods: berries, dark leafy greens, salmon, and walnuts.
Stay hydrated to support lymphatic drainage and lower-extremity circulation.
Moderate dietary sodium to reduce water retention around the lower body.
postureTips: Strengthen rhomboids and lower traps to prevent rounded shoulders over a narrow ribcage.
Stretch hip flexors daily to support optimal pelvic rotation.
wellness.recovery: Elevate legs for 10-15 minutes post-workout to facilitate venous return; light foam rolling for glutes.

tops: Boatneck, off-the-shoulder, and cowl tops
Structured puff-sleeve or cap-sleeve blouses
Horizontal striped tops
Tops with ruffles or embroidery at shoulders
outerwear: Jackets that hit above the widest part of hips
stylingTips: Draw visual interest upward with statement jewelry, scarves, and distinctive necklines.
Keep bottoms dark, sleek, and unembellished while wearing brighter tones on top.
Choose fluid, drapeable fabrics for skirts and trousers.
avoid: Skinny jeans in light washes
Cargo pants with side thigh pockets
Pleated skirts starting right at hip breadth

inverted_triangle.summary: Broad shoulders and chest with slender hips and legs. Focus on lower-body strength and volume development, with clothing silhouettes that add visual weight to the hips.

fitness.focus: Lower-body hypertrophy (glutes, quads, hamstrings) to establish anatomical balance with upper-body breadth.
exercises: Barbell back squats with progressive overload for quadricep mass
Bulgarian split squats for targeted glute and quad development
Barbell conventional or sumo deadlifts for posterior chain breadth
Walking lunges with dumbbells for lower-body muscle fullness
fitness.cardio: Cycling, stair climbing, or rowing sprints to stimulate leg muscle growth and metabolic rate.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days lower-body focused resistance + 1 day light upper-body maintenance + 1-2 days cardio.

nutritionTips: Ensure sufficient caloric surplus or maintenance with adequate complex carbohydrates to fuel heavy leg sessions.
Incorporate healthy fats (nuts, seeds, olive oil) for hormone synthesis.
Hydrate thoroughly before and after high-volume leg workouts.
postureTips: Open anterior chest muscles (pectoralis major/minor) to counteract forward shoulder bias.
Engage core stability to prevent excessive lumbar arching during heavy compound lifts.
wellness.recovery: Prioritize lower-body mobility: couch stretch for hip flexors and pigeon pose for glutes.

tops: Soft V-neck and scoop neck tops
Raglan sleeve tops
Wrap tops in lightweight drapeable fabrics
Minimalist sleeveless tops with wide straps
outerwear: Peplum jackets that flare at the hips
stylingTips: Add volume, texture, and bright colors to the lower body.
Choose tops with clean, vertical necklines that minimize shoulder visual breadth.
Use eye-catching shoes, patterned trousers, and statement belts.
avoid: Padded shoulder blazers
Boatneck or off-the-shoulder tops
Double-breasted jackets with wide lapels

apple.summary: Weight is distributed primarily around the midsection with relatively slender legs and arms. Focus on deep core bracing, posture alignment, and fluid vertical styling lines.

fitness.focus: Deep core activation (transverse abdominis), posture alignment, and metabolic conditioning to support overall body composition.
exercises: Deadbugs and bird-dogs for deep transverse abdominal bracing
Goblet squats to maintain leg strength and upright posture
Lat pulldowns and face pulls to strengthen the upper back
Farmer's carries for functional total-body and core stability
fitness.cardio: Low-impact steady-state (LISS) cardio such as brisk incline walking or swimming 3-4 days per week.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days full-body functional strength + 3 days low-impact cardio and daily walking.

nutritionTips: Prioritize fiber-rich legumes, cruciferous vegetables, and lean protein to support steady blood glucose.
Minimize refined sugars and ultra-processed foods that encourage visceral fat accumulation.
Enjoy antioxidant-rich teas (green tea) and stay consistently hydrated throughout the day.
postureTips: Avoid slouching when seated: keep ribs stacked directly over the pelvis.
Perform daily chin tucks and thoracic extensions to combat forward head posture.
wellness.recovery: Stress-reducing recovery practices: 10 minutes of diaphragmatic breathing and consistent 8-hour sleep.

tops: Empire waist tops and flowy tunics
V-neck and deep scoop neck blouses
Wrap tops tied softly at the side
Tops with vertical pleating or vertical prints
bottoms: Straight-leg or bootcut jeans with flat elastic waistbands
dresses: Shift dresses with vertical seam details
outerwear: Tailored coats worn open to create vertical lines
stylingTips: Create strong vertical lines using open jackets, vertical stripes, and long necklaces.
Highlight your legs and décolletage while allowing fabrics to drape gently over the midsection.
Choose monochromatic color palettes for a lengthening, streamlined silhouette.
avoid: Tight, body-clinging jerseys around the waist
Wide waist belts cinched tightly over the midriff
Boxy cropped tops ending at the belly

trapezoid.summary: The classic athletic male proportion: broad shoulders, developed chest, and balanced, gently tapered waist and hips. Focus on maintaining symmetrical power, core stability, and sharp tailoring.

fitness.focus: Balanced compound athletic strength, maintaining V-taper symmetry through deltoid caps, upper back, and quad development.
exercises: Barbell bench press and incline dumbbell press for upper chest fullness
Weighted pull-ups and chest-supported rows for a wide V-taper back
Barbell back squats and Romanian deadlifts for lower body power
Hanging leg raises and Pallof presses for anti-rotational core stability
fitness.cardio: High-intensity interval training (HIIT), sprint intervals, or rowing 2 sessions per week.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 4 days upper/lower or push/pull/legs split + 2 days mobility and cardio.

nutritionTips: Maintain high quality protein (1.8 - 2.2g per kg of body weight) to support lean muscle preservation.
Incorporate zinc and magnesium rich foods (lean beef, pumpkin seeds, oysters) to optimize natural testosterone production.
Time complex carbohydrate intake around heavy resistance training sessions.
postureTips: Maintain active shoulder retraction to prevent anterior deltoid dominance and rounded shoulders.
Perform thoracic extensions on a foam roller to counteract desk work.
wellness.recovery: 7-9 hours of restorative sleep; weekly mobility sessions focusing on ankles, hips, and shoulders.

tops: Slim-fit dress shirts with semi-spread collars
Tailored polo shirts with structured plackets
Fitted crew neck tees in premium cotton
Fitted henleys and knit sweaters
bottoms: Tailored wool trousers with gentle taper
suits: Two-button single-breasted suits with notch lapels
outerwear: Fitted leather or suede trucker jackets
stylingTips: Most ready-to-wear menswear is tailored to your proportions; focus on precise shoulder seam placement.
Maintain a clean taper through trouser legs with minimal shoe break.
Highlight your natural V-taper with tapered fits rather than boxy cuts.
avoid: Oversized boxy streetwear that hides your athletic taper
Drop-crotch sweatpants
Excessively padded suit shoulders

inverted_triangle.summary: Prominent athletic V-taper with very broad shoulders and chest tapering down to a narrow waist and hips. Focus on building lower-body leg mass to balance upper breadth, and tailoring clothes that accommodate chest breadth without billowing at the waist.

fitness.focus: Hypertrophy for the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves to establish visual and functional symmetry with a powerful upper torso.
exercises: Heavy barbell back squats and front squats for quadricep mass
Bulgarian split squats for targeted unilateral leg development
Romanian deadlifts and seated leg curls for hamstring fullness
Face pulls and band pull-aparts for rotator cuff health and rear delt balance
fitness.cardio: Incline walking, cycling, or stair-climber sessions to reinforce lower-body muscular endurance.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days lower-body focused strength + 2 days upper-body maintenance and rotator cuff care.

nutritionTips: Ensure sufficient caloric intake to fuel high-volume leg training.
Consume anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids (salmon, flaxseeds) for joint and tendon resilience.
Stay consistently hydrated to prevent muscle cramps in heavy compound lifts.
postureTips: Stretch pectoralis major and latissimus dorsi to prevent internal shoulder rotation.
Strengthen lower traps and serratus anterior for scapular upward rotation.
wellness.recovery: Foam roll quads, IT bands, and lats; incorporate weekly sauna or contrast showers.

tops: Raglan sleeve t-shirts and sweaters
V-neck t-shirts and knitwear that soften shoulder width
Tailored athletic-fit button-downs with elastane stretch
Lightweight drapeable knit polo shirts
bottoms: Relaxed-fit chinos that add lower-body substance
Pleated trousers that create proportional hip volume
Cargo pants with subtle side pockets
suits: Unstructured blazers with natural, soft shoulders
outerwear: Knee-length trench coats with natural shoulders
stylingTips: Draw visual weight downward using textured or lighter-colored trousers.
Have your shirts tailored through the torso to eliminate excess fabric bunching at the waist.
Choose natural, unpadded shoulders on jackets and blazers.
avoid: Heavily padded shoulder suit jackets
Skinny-fit jeans that make your lower body look tiny
Boat neck tops and horizontal shoulder stripes

rectangle.summary: Straight, athletic build where chest, waist, and hips follow an even line with minimal taper. Focus on expanding upper-back and lateral deltoid breadth to create an athletic V-taper illusion.

fitness.focus: Hypertrophy for the lateral deltoids, upper pectorals, and lats to craft a defined taper, combined with glute building.
exercises: Dumbbell lateral raises and cable upright rows for wider shoulder caps
Wide-grip lat pulldowns and bent-over barbell rows for upper back wingspan
Incline dumbbell bench press for clavicular chest thickness
Barbell hip thrusts and walking lunges for lower-body curvature
fitness.cardio: Sprint interval training or rowing machine to stimulate upper-back and posterior chain power.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 4 days hypertrophy training (emphasis on lateral delts and lats) + 1-2 days active recovery.

nutritionTips: Maintain a slight caloric surplus (250-400 kcal) if aiming to build shoulder and back breadth.
Eat quality lean proteins (chicken, eggs, Greek yogurt) distributed across 4-5 meals daily.
Consume complex carbohydrates before workouts to maximize training intensity.
postureTips: Engage in scapular retractions and chest-opening stretches to stand tall and broad.
Avoid slouching over keyboards to keep the ribcage open.
wellness.recovery: Prioritize 8 hours of sleep; stretch lats and chest post-training to maintain mobility.

tops: Layered overshirts and casual shirts over fitted tees
Horizontal-striped Breton shirts that widen the chest
Structured shirts with chest pockets and epaulets
Chunky textured knit sweaters (cable knit)
suits: Structured blazers with light shoulder padding to define the upper frame
Double-breasted jackets to build chest presence
outerwear: Leather biker jackets with structured shoulders
Quilted jackets with horizontal baffle patterns
stylingTips: Use layering (open jacket over crew neck) to add dimensional depth and breadth.
Opt for jackets with subtle shoulder padding to create a structured silhouette.
Choose contrast waistbands or tuck in shirts with a quality belt to break up the vertical block.
avoid: Unstructured shapeless sack coats
Vertical pinstripe suits without shoulder definition
Skin-tight monochrome t-shirts

triangle.summary: Lower torso (waist and hips) is wider than the chest and shoulders. Focus on upper-body breadth in the gym and structured tailoring that squares off the shoulders while streamlining the midsection.

fitness.focus: Developing upper-torso breadth (shoulders, chest, upper back) and full-body metabolic conditioning to balance lower torso proportions.
exercises: Standing barbell overhead press for total shoulder development
Incline dumbbell presses to elevate the upper chest line
Cable lateral raises and face pulls for deltoid cap widening
Kettlebell swings and goblet squats for metabolic conditioning
fitness.cardio: Incline treadmill walking or rowing machine to build upper body stamina while burning calories.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3-4 days upper-body focused resistance + 2 days cardiovascular conditioning.

nutritionTips: Focus on nutrient-dense whole foods: high fiber, lean proteins, and complex carbohydrates.
Stay hydrated to enhance metabolic efficiency and decrease water retention around the midriff.
Reduce alcohol and sugary beverages that contribute to visceral and abdominal adiposity.
postureTips: Stand tall with proud chest: imagine drawing the shoulder blades together and downward.
Avoid hunching shoulders inward which makes the upper body look narrower.
wellness.recovery: Foam roll the thoracic spine and stretch the chest to open upper posture.

tops: Vertical-striped dress shirts
Structured polo shirts with crisp collars
Crew neck sweaters with shoulder detailing
Dark, tailored button-down shirts
bottoms: Flat-front mid-rise chinos in navy, charcoal, or black
Trousers tailored to fall cleanly over footwear
suits: Single-breasted two-button suits with structured shoulders and notch lapels
Navy tailored sports coat with light shoulder roping
outerwear: Single-breasted trench coats and car coats
Harrington jackets that hit right at the hip
stylingTips: Wear darker colors on your lower half and lighter or patterned colors on your upper half.
Jackets with structured shoulders provide instant proportion balance.
Keep trousers flat-fronted and streamlined around the hips and waist.
avoid: Skinny tapered jeans that accentuate hip width
Horizontal stripes across the abdomen
Double-breasted jackets that add bulk to the midsection

oval.summary: Weight is carried primarily through the midsection, with relatively narrower shoulders and limbs. Focus on full-body functional strength, posture alignment, and clean monochromatic vertical lines.

fitness.focus: Full-body compound movements and metabolic resistance training to improve body composition and spinal posture.
exercises: Farmer's walks with heavy dumbbells for functional grip, core, and posture strength
Chest-supported dumbbell rows to build mid-back endurance without spinal load
Goblet squats with a kettlebell for lower-body power and upright posture
Landmine presses for joint-friendly upper-body pushing power
fitness.cardio: Low-impact steady-state (LISS) cardio: brisk incline walking, elliptical, or swimming 3-4 days per week.
fitness.weeklyStructure: 3 days full-body functional strength training + 3 days low-impact cardiovascular activity.

nutritionTips: Focus on steady-state blood sugar control: emphasize leafy greens, lean meats, fish, and legumes.
Keep evening meals lighter and allow 2-3 hours between dinner and sleep for optimal digestion.
Prioritize quality hydration: start the day with 500ml of water.
postureTips: Counteract anterior pelvic tilt by activating glutes during standing.
Perform chin tucks and wall angels to align head and neck over the spine.
wellness.recovery: Consistent 7-8 hours of sleep; gentle daily walking for active recovery and lymphatic flow.

tops: Dark solid-tone button-down shirts
V-neck sweaters and tees that elongate the neck
Shirts with subtle vertical stripes
Spread collar shirts that complement a broader face
bottoms: Relaxed straight-leg trousers in charcoal, navy, or black
Dark-wash straight jeans with clean lines
Trousers worn at the natural waistline with suspenders or clean waistband
suits: Two-button single-breasted suits in dark matte wool
Suits with deep V-gorge that elongates the torso
outerwear: Tailored mac coats worn open to form vertical lines
stylingTips: Monochromatic dark outfits (e.g. all navy or all charcoal) create a sleek, slimming vertical line.
Wear jackets open or loosely buttoned to create slimming vertical borders.
Avoid tight horizontal breaks like contrasting bright belts.
avoid: Tight, clinging cotton jerseys across the belly
Horizontal stripes or loud prints on the stomach
Cropped or waist-length jackets that highlight midriff volume
